Media.Info.Title: About MediaMonitor
Media.Info.Description:
MediaMonitor allows you to know which media are currently playing or have been played.
The process can be automated depending on the machine's activity period.
A report can be sent automatically before shutdown or manually via the interface.
Media.Actions.Title: Report Automation
Media.Service.Label: MediaMonitor Service
Wake.Description: WakeMonitor can report information about what caused your machine to wake up. This information is sent by email.
Wake.Options.Title: Information to include in the email
Stop.Description: StopMonitor allows you to know why your machine started or restarted via a scheduled task.
Shutdown.Title: Scheduled Shutdown
WOL.Title: Automatic Startup (Wake On Lan)
WOL.Description:
To automatically start your machine, you must use the Wake On Lan method.

You must enable the feature in the BIOS, and also in the Windows Device Manager.

If you do not want to use WOL, you will need to start your machine manually.
